title: Global Fundamental-Parameter Mapping of Lunar Elemental Abundances from Chandrayaan-2 CLASS XRF Data with Cross-Modal Super-Resolution
description: Pipeline for fundamental-parameter forward modelling and TRF spectral fitting of Chandrayaan-2 CLASS XRF data, adaptive-Gaussian spatial abundance mapping, cross-modal guided super-resolution, and Apollo/Luna ground-truth validation. Accompanies a paper submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS).
